units.source_text: 且说藤壶皇后发心在桐壶院周年忌辰之后举办一次法会，

en.t: Meanwhile, Empress Fujitsubo resolved to hold a Buddhist memorial service after the first anniversary of Emperor Kiritsubo's death,

units.source_text: 请高僧讲演《法华经》八卷，目下正操心做种种准备。

en.t: inviting eminent monks to lecture on all eight volumes of the Lotus Sutra, and she was now anxiously making all sorts of preparations.

units.source_text: 国忌是十一月初一，是日天上降下一片大雪。

en.t: The imperial memorial day fell on the first day of the eleventh month, and on that day heavy snow came falling from the sky.

units.source_text: 源氏大将赋诗寄藤壶皇后：

en.t: General Genji composed a poem and sent it to Empress Fujitsubo:
